title: SQL Injection at http://localhost:3000/
basis: Signal-based: a database engine error was returned when a single unmatched quote was submitted, proving unsanitized input reaches the SQL parser. No data was extracted and no rows were altered.

evidence.response:
OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)

500 Error: SQLITE_ERROR: near ""%' OR description LIKE '%'"": syntax error
evidence.note: SQL Injection — stack disclosure: DB error surfaced by a quote probe (error-based SQLi signal)

remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for every database access and never concatenate untrusted input into SQL. Add allow-list input validation and run the application under a least-privilege database account.

title: SQL Injection — Authentication Bypass at http://localhost:3000/
basis: Impact-confirmed: the injected predicate established an authenticated session without valid credentials, so authentication was actually bypassed. The probe only reads the auth table — no credential is altered and no account is locked.

evidence.note: `' OR 1=1--` in the email field returned HTTP 200 with a signed JWT and no valid credentials

remediation: Use parameterized queries for the authentication lookup so credentials can never alter query structure, and never build the login SQL by string concatenation. Add server-side rate limiting and generic auth-failure responses.

title: Broken Access Control — Privilege Escalation at http://localhost:3000/
basis: Impact-confirmed: the session from the bypass step reached an admin-only resource, so the privilege boundary was actually crossed (read-only access to the restricted surface).

evidence.note: unauthenticated this endpoint returns 401; with the JWT from step 1 it returns 200 and admin-only data — authenticated access the agent was never granted

remediation: Enforce server-side role checks on every admin resource against the authenticated principal, deny by default, and reject tokens whose subject lacks the admin role instead of trusting a valid signature alone.
